assertions.name: posts survive
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post

assertions.name: collections survive
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM collection

assertions.name: thread collection memberships survive
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection

assertions.name: navigation survives
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM nav_item

assertions.name: paths survive
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM path_registry

assertions.name: media survives
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM media

assertions.name: every post's thread root exists
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post p LEFT JOIN post root ON root.site_id = p.site_id AND root.id = p.thread_id WHERE root.id IS NULL

assertions.name: thread collection targets are roots
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection tc INNER JOIN post root ON root.site_id = tc.site_id AND root.id = tc.thread_id WHERE root.reply_to_id IS NOT NULL OR root.thread_id <> root.id
